text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock A and D after gains brought satisfaction, but may have cut exposure too early; I should base exits on future prospects and portfolio balance, not the pleasure of locking in profits.","Selling Stock E at a loss hurt, yet holding to avoid that feeling can be costly. I should reassess each position objectively rather than anchor on my average cost.","My account has fluctuated despite several profitable sales. I should follow a consistent risk-aware plan, diversify, and avoid letting frequent monitoring trigger reactive trades."]}
